name: Mr. Hyde
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets. Transylvania's seat 2, the other half of Jekyll's seat. The master is the rest pose's OWN head. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. Built at 0.88 (`scale`): the sheets drew him hunched but not small, and Stevenson's Hyde is small. The broken cane lies on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest and a props box in every frame.

what.A1: Rest: hairy hands on the felt, apart, the broken cane by his right hand
what.A2: Peek: right hand cupped low over the felt
what.A3: Check: a hairy knuckle raps the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand shoves forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand shoved well forward
what.A6: Fold: a contemptuous flick of the hand
what.B1: All in: both hands shove forward together, grinning
what.B2: Show: right hand slaps palm up
what.B3: Big win: both fists raised, a gleeful, nasty grin (`win_big`)
what.B4: The displeasing smile, slow and wide
what.B5: Sucks his teeth, head cocked (decoy for B4)
what.B6: Drums his hairy knuckles on the felt
what.C2: Hunches down into the too-big coat, collar up round his ears
what.C3: Shoves the long sleeves back up his arms (decoy for C2)
what.C5: Sniggers to himself, a hand over his mouth
what.C6: Arrive: scrambling up into the chair, the big coat slipping off one shoulder
what.D2: Facing a big bet: chin low, eyes narrowed, a hand on the broken cane
what.D3: Lost a pot: a sneer, a shove of the hand
what.D4: Crushing loss: both fists slammed on the felt, teeth bared (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in low on both forearms

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the broken cane by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
